Reasoning: This stage keeps the current panda_fingertip pose fixed while establishing a real grasp on the marker. freeze_position enforces the current end-effector origin position within 0.01 m and represents commanding no translational motion. freeze_orientation enforces the current end-effector orientation with the supported 0.2 rad tolerance and represents commanding no angular motion. object_grasped is used instead of close_gripper because the stage requires grasp success to be based on the marker being physically held, not merely on the finger joints reaching a closed position. The API cannot explicitly encode bilateral finger joint synchronization, left/right joint position monitoring, or finger squeeze/contact effort thresholds, so those details are omitted; the representable grasp confirmation is object_grasped.
